{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorlift stabilizers''' were propulsion units used in [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]]. The [[DRPV-78 Rocket Pack]] used miniaturized repulsorlift stabilizers along with specialized liquid [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] mixtures to provide longer flight times.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
